name: Haus Stefanie
beschreibung: The Haus Stefanie welcomes holidaymakers to a peaceful, sunny setting in Sölden within the Tyrolean Ötztal, framed by the impressive scenery of the Ötztal Alps. Styled with warm alpine timber finishes, the comfortable guest rooms feature modern en-suite bathrooms, satellite TV, and sunny balconies with sweeping views of the surrounding snow-clad peaks. Each morning, a nutritious breakfast buffet loaded with local regional specialities prepares guests for active outdoor exploration. The complimentary ski bus stops just moments away, providing straightforward transport to the valley stations of the Giggijoch and Gaislachkogl gondolas, doors to Sölden's twin glacier ski slopes. In summer, panoramic hiking paths and the Bike Republic Sölden tracks lie close at hand.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine guesthouse in a quiet location in Sölden in the Ötztal with comfortable rooms and swift access to Sölden's ski area.
